name: What is the typical cost range for a room addition?
description: Room addition costs typically range from $50,000 to over $200,000, influenced by size, materials, and complexity.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a room addition can vary widely, typically ranging from $50,000 to over $200,000, depending on factors like size, materials, finishes, and the complexity of plumbing or electrical work. Specialty rooms like kitchens or bathrooms tend to be more expensive per square foot due to fixtures and utility requirements. A key decision factor is balancing your budget with your desired outcome, considering that higher-end finishes or complex structural changes will increase the overall investment.
